_schema.price_status: verified = the price was read directly from the provider's public pricing page on verified_on. unverified = specs are confirmed but the price could not be read (JS-rendered or region-gated) and must be filled in by a human before it is allowed into a published calculation.
_schema.policy: Only plans with price_status = verified and a non-null price_usd_month are allowed to feed a published TCO figure. Everything else renders as a spec-only listing. scripts/check_staleness.py enforces the review window.

providers.name: DigitalOcean
providers.billing_note: Per-second billing since 1 January 2026, with a minimum charge of 60 seconds or $0.01. Monthly caps still apply.
weaknesses: Roughly 2-3x the price of European budget hosts for the same RAM

providers.name: Hetzner Cloud
providers.billing_note: Priced in EUR. Hourly billing capped at a monthly maximum. IPv4 is charged separately on some plans.
strengths: Best price per GB of RAM among mainstream hosts
20 TB of included traffic on EU plans
weaknesses: EU, US and Singapore regions only
EUR billing adds currency risk for USD budgets
Popular plans go out of stock
providers.price_note: Specs below were read from the Hetzner pricing pages on 2026-09-12. The prices are injected client-side per region and every plan was reported as temporarily unavailable at the time of reading, so no price could be captured.

providers.name: Kamatera
providers.billing_note: Fixed monthly plans, billed by the minute. The pricing page lists extra traffic at $0.01 per GB and extra storage at $0.05 per GB per month; neither is included in the figures on this site.
strengths: Its 1 GB plan is the cheapest 1 GB server among the providers we have priced
The fixed plans run on dedicated CPU threads, according to the pricing page
Billed by the minute, which suits short trials
weaknesses: Every fixed plan includes only 20 GB of disk, so most multi-container tools need paid extra storage
Above 1 GB of memory, the fixed plans cost more than DigitalOcean for the same RAM
providers.price_note: Read from the three fixed plans on the Kamatera pricing page on 2026-09-14. Kamatera also sells custom configurations through a calculator whose per-component prices were not shown, so only the fixed plans are used here.

providers.name: Vultr
providers.billing_note: Hourly billing with a monthly cap. 32 global regions.
strengths: Widest region coverage of the budget hosts
weaknesses: Support is community-first on lower tiers
providers.price_note: The pricing table sits behind a consent gate and lazy rendering, so no plan could be read on 2026-09-12.

providers.name: PikaPods
providers.billing_note: Pay-per-resource managed hosting of open-source apps. No server administration.
strengths: No sysadmin work at all, which removes the labour line entirely
Per-app pricing suits a single tool
Cheapest honest option below roughly 10 users
weaknesses: App catalogue is curated, not arbitrary
Costs scale per app rather than per server
providers.price_note: Its resource-based pricing could not be read programmatically.
